name: lovebyte.exe
source:
Your kamioshi's stream abruptly ends one day & his silence creates rampant rumors. Avoiding the online toxicity, you join a degenerate group chat where VTuber fans chat about their oshis freely. But you start noticing strange coincidences - is your kamioshi in this chat? 

In this dating chatsim, who's real & who's pretending in chat?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3491690/lovebyteexe/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
某一天，你的“神推”直播中途戛然而止，而他随后的彻底失联更是在网上引发了满城风雨的流言蜚语。为了躲避网上的乌烟瘴气，你加入了一个供VTuber粉丝们畅聊各自“推”的混沌水群，却渐渐察觉到一连串蹊跷的巧合——难道你的神推本人就潜伏在这个群里？

在这部群聊恋爱模拟游戏中，群里究竟谁才是真人本尊，谁又在逢场作戏？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3491690/lovebyteexe/]Steam[/url]]
